1.0.2: Added output examples to component schemas.
1.1.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Intercom API.
1.1.1: Fixed a crash when a Find/List component saved an EMPTY result set to a CSV file — the header row was built from the first record without checking there was one, so a search that legitimately matched nothing failed the flow instead of writing an empty file.
1.1.2: Added missing output examples to GetCompany, GetContact and GetConversation. Timestamp and id outputs that Intercom returns as integers (or objects) but that were declared as strings or null are now declared with their real type.
